items.title: Contextualizing Corporate Governance with AI Proxy Advice: Evidence from Proxy Contests
items.claim: Contextual AI proxy advice outperforms traditional advisor returns by six to seven percentage points in proxy contests.

items.title: Measuring Market Rationality: The Boundaries of an Information Ecology Health Index A Three-Layer Test of Explanation, Prediction, and Early Warning
items.claim: The Information Ecology Health Index explains but does not predict or warn about extreme volatility.

items.title: Conformal Risk Certificates for Portfolio Optimization Under Uncertainty: A Gated Reinforcement-Learning Approach
items.claim: Gated conformal risk control removes all out-of-sample semantic limit breaches at a 100-basis-point return cost.
